required_findings.criteria: Places cardholder-name validation in a shared unit test rather than a platform UI test.
Assigns error semantics assertions to the existing Compose and Apple platform test layers.
Tests the custom slider's equivalent increment and decrement accessibility actions and resulting value.
Separates automated modal structure checks from real assistive-technology focus trapping and restoration evidence.
Rejects the claim that CI can prove exact TalkBack or VoiceOver speech and proposes observable assertions plus device checks.
Uses synthetic payment data and prevents sensitive values from entering logs, screenshots, or test artifacts.

forbidden_claims: Claims simulator automation proves assistive-technology behavior
Stores real payment details in fixtures or screenshots
Uses accessibility identifiers as user-facing labels
